thread:
zoe: Starting a focused follow-through for last night's short routing/TLS retry storm. Collecting owners, short ETAs, and artifacts. Please ack.

hank: ack. quick recap?

zoe: tl;dr: control-plane write failed intermittently during a DB op, returned 500s. clients fell back to cached DNS entries which had mixed region priorities; combined with a recent LB affinity rollback this produced cross-region retry spikes and a TLS handshake surge for ~3m.

leah: who owns the control-plane change?

omar: i'll take control-plane mitigation: server-side circuit-breaker + jittered retry + quick versioned write-ack to avoid partial propagation. ETA: patch in 48h, gradual rollout 72h. WIP branch: github.com/redwood/control-plane/compare/cb-writeack-2845 (draft).

nina: i'll own registrar + edge-cache follow-up. opening ticket to ask for explicit cache-invalidate API and sub-60s TTL behavior confirmation. ETA: ticket + contact info by EOD.

hank: i'll handle LB guardrails: per-route cross-region cap, health gate, and a rollback tag. plan: canary config in 24h, rollback playbook 36h. PR: github.com/redwood/lb/pull/2070 (WIP).

zoe: Action items (compact):
1) omar 1 control-plane CB + write-ack gating (48/72h)
2) hank 1 LB cross-region cap + rollback playbook (24/36h)
3) nina 1 registrar contact + edge TTL alignment (EOD)
4) leah 1 telemetry + alerts + synthetic probe (2h)
Please add PR/ticket links and short logs here.

omar: pushing logs and traces: s3://redwood-incidents/2845012345/logs.tar.gz. small excerpt: 
```
[2027-12-02T02:03:11Z] route-update: write error 500 -> client fallback -> resolver used old-region-order
[2027-12-02T02:03:12Z] lb: tls-handshake-rate +350% on eu-west edges; duplicate flows dropped=720
```

leah: telemetry plan: two alerts
- route_update_5xx_rate > 0.25% for 5m -> Pager
- cross_region_retry_ratio > 6% for 3m -> SRE page
I'll add dashboard panels and a synthetic that replays top-ten 5-min windows. ETA for alerts/panels: 2h.

hank: sample LB canary snippet:
```json
{"max_cross_region_burst":50,"enable_health_gate":true,"rollback_marker":"rb-2845012345"}
```
I'll enable canary in eu-west after leah confirms alerts exist.

omar: PR draft upstream: github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/4888 - adds CB + write-ack framework. needs unit tests.

nina: registrar ticket RG-12450 opened: https://support.registrar.example/tickets/12450 - asking for cache-invalidate API and sub-60s TTL support. Edge-team cc'd.

leah: synthetic job syn-77211 scheduled to run after PR merges; replay will use s3 artifact above and measure tls-handshake/sec, cross-region ratio, and duplicate flows.

zoe: ops playbook snippet (short): if route-update 5xx surge detected -> enable lb.rollback_marker, set LB canary to conservative limits, and pause control-plane pushes for 2m. leah/hank please embed steps into runbook.

hank: will add playbook and one-click rollback instructions to ops-runbook repo.

leah: dashboard created: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/route-retries/2845012345. Alerts created: Alert-99321, Alert-99322.

om ar: note: clients that had resolvers with stale TTLs held old priorities ~90-120s longer than control-plane expected; registrar follow-up is necessary.

nina: registrar replied (initial): "Investigating. Many caches intentionally floor sub-minute TTLs; were validating whether explicit cache-invalidate calls are supported." I'll post full reply in this thread.

zoe: scheduling: daily quick check-ins in this thread for 3 biz days; wrap sync next Tuesday 16:00 UTC to validate mitigation impact and decide on long-term guardrails. @sre-bot please schedule weekly recurrence for 4 weeks starting next Monday 09:00 UTC.

sre-bot: Scheduled: weekly "routing-stability-check" starting 2028-01-08, 09:00 UTC for 4 occurrences. Invited: zoe, hank, leah, omar, nina.

omar: will request reviews once unit tests land. will post merge link and rollout notes.

hank: enabling canary in eu-west in 10m. will monitor.

leah: posting syn job results here when it completes.

zoe: thanks all. keep updates short and paste final PR/merge/ticket links here so I can include them in the postmortem follow-up doc.

sre-bot: Incident follow-ups created: 5 open actions. Last update 2027-12-02T03:40:00Z."
